jmbu...@news.amherst.edu (Ewok) writes:

>1) Is it possible, as an action, to transfer a vampire to another
>Methuselah? Even if it isn't, it would be an interesting house rule.

No. Possibly. More interesting than useful, I'd imagine.

>2) Can someone (tom) clear up whether more than one additional strike
>card can be use in one combat turn? And if this has changed between
>Jyhad and V:tes?

Neither lets you *gain* additional strikes more than once in a round.
Jyhad (RT interp) allows you to *play* more than one additional strike card,
with only the first being used to *gain* additional strike(s).
This imagined loophole has been closed by the VtES rules.

Reference:

From: aa...@cats.ucsc.edu (Thomas R Wylie)

>o. Only one Additional Strike card may be played by a minion per round.
> (Additional Strike card is any card that bestows additional strike(s).)
> [LSJ] [ASHK] [JHJ]

This is the rule in VTES.
